newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh buys white sugar at $348.5 per tonne.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh buys white sugar at $348.5 per tonne.

text.p: DHAKA, March 25 (Reuter) Bangladesh's state-owned Sugar and Food Corporation has bought 25,000 tonnes of white sugar at C & F $348.5 per tonne for shipment by May 15, corporation officials said on Tuesday.
They said G. Premjee of Britain won the deal in a weekend bidding. The first instalment of 12,500 tonnes of cargo should reach Chittagong port by May 8 and the rest by May 15, they said.
